name: meka
description: A private local control plane above Codex and Claude Code.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @meka/workflow run build && pnpm --filter @meka/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @meka/app run build
scripts.check:dist: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.package-consumer.json && node scripts/check-built-workflow-runtime.mjs
scripts.check:types: pnpm --filter @meka/workflow run check:types && pnpm --filter @meka/sdk run check:types && pnpm --filter @meka/app run check:types
